🫏 New post ready 📖 Story · love · 7 slides “we still have that chipped yellow bowl that doesn't match anything else in the cupboard.” 📝 Slides
1. we still have that chipped yellow bowl that doesn't match anything else in the cupboard. 2. we bought it at a yard sale on a saturday morning when our whole kitchen fit in two cardboard boxes. 3. it survived four apartment moves, two chipped floor tiles, and the winter the radiator leaked. 4. yesterday you dropped it on the kitchen floor, and we both froze like we had broken something expensive. 5. but it didn't shatter. it just spun on the linoleum and settled between our bare feet. 6. so you wiped it dry, and put it right back on the top shelf where it belongs. 7. we built a whole life out of things we were too stubborn to throw away.
✍️ Caption
we still use the mismatched plates and the cups that came from different sets. my partner keeps putting them right at the front of the cupboard anyway. send this to the one who knows which chipped mug is yours. #relationshipquotes #quotesaboutlove #couplequotes
